mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia can potentiate corticosteroid side effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; fluticasone may worsen fluid retention opposing diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly; consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation; assess for signs of hypokalemia-related cardiac effects.
